turns.prompt_text: how do you make ink from walnuts
turns.response_html: To make walnut ink, boil or simmer black walnut husks in water for several hours until the liquid is a rich brown and has reduced in volume. Then, strain the liquid to remove solids. You can optionally boil it again to thicken the ink and add a preservative like rubbing alcohol or whole cloves to prevent mold.
